p0.title: The production analyzer replaces the frozen cycle-accurate shared-resource machine with aggregate counters
evidence: service_group always charges a fixed 12 productive plus 2 L4-wait cycles and has no response/O8/1RW/RAW state
19 of 27 primary classes have no explicit production charge site
all dense destinations are unconditionally charged as zero-build plus 32 plus 3 with no resident/backing/shared-link/sink-ready state
xorshift ready is used only by static_self_test and terminal_tail only bulk-charges counts
A1-OSG omits mandatory per-bundle BUNDLE_RETIRE and has no fixed reusable context-index state
p0.impact: A1 and PBR4 totals are not the M559 same-resource cycle coordinate; any future ratio is invalid.

p0.title: Numeric, traffic, equivalence and GO gates can produce a false PASS
evidence: decoder weight members are never opened and no signed INT8 or Acc24 data path exists
commit_hash is never updated and both mismatch fields are hard-coded zero
mandatory occupancy/refill/backing/output/commit ledgers and aggregate traffic are absent
GO checks only aggregate speed 1.30 and per-sample 1.10
functional, weight/refill, hidden-state and OSG group/RMW/commit non-equivalence gates are absent; support-only is not implemented
p0.impact: An incorrect or OSG-equivalent candidate can be emitted as PASS_CPU_GO.

p0.title: Runtime N0-N8 revalidation and A1 receipt freeze are incomplete
evidence: future_runner_schema and contract-static authorization bindings are never rehashed
authorization contract_path/schema/status and production resident/terminal goldens are not checked
wrapper_path is not required to be the canonical reviewed wrapper path
A1_ONLY_RECEIPT is sealed but not verify_directory-rehashed before PBR4 becomes visible
p0.impact: The prescribed closed identity DAG and fixed A1-STRONG selection are not enforced at runtime.

p1.title: Frozen exact cohort totals and metadata are not validated
p1.evidence: EXPECTED_RAW_BITS, EXPECTED_REPLAY_BITS and EXPECTED_DENSE_DESTINATIONS have zero production AST loads; record_map checks only 40 tuple keys and the sealed verifier is not semantically parsed.

p1.title: Post-attempt failure closure has operations outside the protected try block
p1.evidence: attempt creation/write/seal and staging mkdir precede try, so failures can leave unsealed partial state without a quarantined FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE receipt.

p2.title: Builtin golden coverage is only a smoke test
p2.evidence: It checks SC8/ISO8 aggregate 18-cycle counts but not event hashes, OSG=22, PBR4=21 or the production terminal state path.

decision.only_allowed_next_step: author a new repaired analyzer/runner source identity and request a fresh static hammer
